It is a name that resonates with the values of endurance, resilience, and steadfastness, virtues that are highly valued in Islamic society. The name has a historic and poetic significance, as the ancient kingdom of Yemen, from which the name is derived, was known for its strength and steadfastness in the face of numerous challenges. Yamaan is a name that evokes a sense of pride and heritage, connecting the bearer to the rich cultural traditions of the Islamic world.

He describes them as living in the southwestern part of the peninsula, and being distinct from the other tribes by their dark complexion and their agricultural lifestyle.

He describes it as being located in the southwestern part of the Arabian Peninsula, and being known for its agricultural productivity, especially in dates and bananas.
